{{Quote|I am Roshal Bek, major domo to Broga the Hutt.|Roshal Bek|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Roshal Bek''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. He was a servant of [[Broga Masrii|Broga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] of the [[Three Families]] that broke away from the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]]. He accompanied his master to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quesh]] where during the [[Quesh war]], he survived an attack by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Magras]] that saw his master kidnapped.
